reason: I have strictly avoided third-party cloud tools because I cannot risk client ITR, PAN, and ROC files leaking from external databases. While keeping files in my own Google Drive sounds promising, I will not pay a single rupee until I personally test the free pilot and verify that Docketra's OAuth permissions physically isolate it from the rest of my Drive.
objection: Can I independently verify that Docketra's API connection cannot read, index, or expose any confidential client files outside the /Docketra/ folder in my Google Drive?
would_change_my_mind: A successful test of the free pilot with verified restricted-scope OAuth permissions proving zero access to my existing Drive files and guaranteed local data custody.
